name: setup-manaflow-ai-halo-look
description: A whole cmux look after a minimal chat assistant desktop app: a near-monochrome white theme (Halo) and a near-black one (Halo Dark), airy spacing and a centered column, prompts in soft bubbles, a pill message box, a quiet header and a sidebar of plain titles with no timestamps, icons or colors. Built only from public surfaces; remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Halo sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Halo's hover card and sidebar rows: the title and the last reply only, regular names and a small dot while work runs.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
files.themes/halo-dark.json:
// Halo Dark: near-monochrome black. A near-black page (#212121), the sidebar darker (#171717),
// off-white ink (#ececec), a neutral gray selection and white as the accent.
{
  "name": "Halo Dark",
  "description": "Near-monochrome black: a near-black page, a darker sidebar, off-white ink, no accent color.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Dark",
  // The window, sidebar and pages take that theme too, over an App Theme of your own.
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "colors": { "background": "#212121", "foreground": "#ececec", "selection": "#383838", "accent": "#ececec" },
  "appearance.accent": "neutral",

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "oneColor",
  "appearance.density": "spacious",

  "appearance.metrics.sidebarWidth": 260,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 36,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 13,

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#171717",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#212121",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#212121",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot"
}
files.themes/halo.json:
// Halo: near-monochrome white. A white page, the sidebar a whisper of gray (#f9f9f9), near-black
// ink (#0d0d0d), a neutral gray selection, and black as the accent: no color but the content's.
{
  "name": "Halo",
  "description": "Near-monochrome white: a white page, a whisper-gray sidebar, near-black ink, no accent color.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  // The window, sidebar and pages take that theme too, over an App Theme of your own.
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "colors": { "background": "#ffffff", "foreground": "#0d0d0d", "selection": "#ececec", "accent": "#0d0d0d" },
  "appearance.accent": "neutral",

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "oneColor",
  "appearance.density": "spacious",

  // Proportions: a 260 pt sidebar of 36 pt rows, 13 pt chrome text, wide gaps.
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarWidth": 260,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 36,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 13,

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#f9f9f9",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot"
}
